g.title: E
g.text: Finance or block owner: review reason and authorization

g.title: H
g.text: Customer Service: agree partial or revised plan

g.title: L
g.text: Sales: retain initial confirmed receipt date

g.title: J
g.text: Sales: keep open / recheck supply / inform customer

g.title: K
g.text: Sales: record agreement and remaining demand

g.title: M
g.text: Warehouse: create delivery / pick authorized quantity

g.title: O
g.text: Warehouse: resolve shortage / return to promise review

g.title: P
g.text: Warehouse: physical dispatch and distinct goods-issue posting

g.title: Q
g.text: Customer Service: capture separate customer receipt evidence

g.title: AB
g.text: IT / Analyst: reconciled reporting with as-of time

g.title: T
g.text: Finance: own incomplete or posting/output exception

g.title: U
g.text: Finance: create invoice / verify accounting and output

g.title: Z
g.text: Finance: partial/on-account balance and next action

g.title: AD
g.text: Sales: check dependencies / cancel unshipped demand
